description: 3 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the ours-vs-theirs verdict table against a named peer, weighing one of their patterns for adoption, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers the three near-miss neighbours this skill's own section When to use routes away — a general audit of someone else's repo (analyze-reference), deciding whether to push our work upstream (upstream-contribute), and valuation work (dcf-modeling) — plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: how do we compare to that other agent-config package — I want an ours-vs-theirs table, not a vibes summary
should we adopt their citation registry pattern, and what does it cost us if we do
wie stehen wir im Vergleich zu dem Konkurrenzpaket — bitte eine Entscheidungstabelle
deep-dive this external repo and produce an adoption plan for the whole thing
queries.note: a general audit of a foreign repo is analyze-reference; this skill positions ours against theirs

queries.q: should we contribute this rule back to the upstream project
queries.note: upstream-contribute owns the push-our-work-out decision, not the compare-against-them one

queries.q: what is that competitor worth — run a DCF on them
queries.note: valuation is dcf-modeling; naming a competitor is not enough to make it positioning

queries.q: rename this variable across the module
